passages.title: 재고 실사 협조 요청 메일
passages.passage:
From: Inventory Control
To: All Store Managers, Northeast Region
Subject: Year-End Physical Inventory — January 7

Dear Managers,

The annual physical inventory count will take place on Sunday, January 7, when all stores are closed. Count teams of four will visit each store; managers must be present to open the store and verify the final tally.

Before the count: process all pending returns by January 5, clear receiving areas of unscanned stock, and print shelf labels for any relocated sections. Stores that completed these steps last year finished counting two hours faster on average.

Discrepancies above 0.5 percent of stock value trigger a recount of the affected categories the following weekend. Final results feed directly into the annual financial statements, so accuracy matters more than speed.

Please confirm your store's readiness in the operations portal by January 3.

Inventory Control Team

questions.q: Why was January 7 chosen for the count?
choices: Stores are closed on that Sunday
It is the fiscal year start
Count teams were only free then
questions.exKo: 전 매장이 문을 닫는 일요일이라 실사가 가능합니다.
questions.ev: on Sunday, January 7, when all stores are closed

questions.q: What benefit did prepared stores see last year?
questions.exKo: 사전 준비를 마친 매장은 평균 2시간 빨리 끝났습니다.
why: 사전 준비 매장이 평균 2시간 빨리 끝냄
questions.ev: Stores that completed these steps last year finished counting two hours faster on average.

questions.q: What happens if discrepancies exceed 0.5 percent?
choices: Affected categories are recounted the next weekend
questions.exKo: 재고 가치의 0.5%를 넘는 차이는 다음 주말 재실사 대상입니다.
why: 0.5% 초과 시 다음 주말 해당 품목 재실사
아무 조치 없다는 것은 지문과 반대
questions.ev: Discrepancies above 0.5 percent of stock value trigger a recount of the affected categories the following weekend.

passages.title: 고객 계약 해지 만류 메일
passages.passage:
From: Account Management, Streamly Analytics
To: Jared Kim, Operations Director, Novacart
Subject: Before You Go — A Proposal

Dear Mr. Kim,

We received your notice of non-renewal and understand budget pressure is the main driver. Before your access ends March 31, I would like to offer an alternative to full cancellation.

Our new Essentials tier includes the dashboard and weekly reports your team uses most — based on your usage data, these account for over 80 percent of your activity — at 45 percent below your current plan. Advanced forecasting and the API would no longer be included, though they can be re-added anytime.

If you would like, I can also arrange a session with our analysts to export your historical data in whatever format your team needs — that service is free regardless of your decision.

Could we talk for 15 minutes this week? If Essentials is not a fit, I will make the offboarding as smooth as possible.

Best regards,
Tania Flores

questions.q: What is the main purpose of the email?
choices: To offer a cheaper plan instead of cancellation
questions.exKo: 전면 해지 대신 45% 저렴한 하위 요금제를 제안하는 메일입니다.

questions.q: What supports the Essentials recommendation?
questions.exKo: 사용 데이터상 대시보드와 주간 보고서가 활동의 80% 이상이기 때문입니다.

questions.q: What is offered free regardless of the decision?
questions.exKo: 결정과 무관하게 과거 데이터 내보내기 지원은 무료입니다.

passages.title: 구내 우체국 서비스 종료 공지
passages.passage:
POSTAL COUNTER CLOSING — ALTERNATIVES AVAILABLE

The postal counter in the basement arcade will close permanently on June 30, as the national postal service consolidates small branches. We negotiated the following alternatives for building tenants:

1. A self-service parcel locker will be installed by the west entrance in mid-June, handling stamped mail, prepaid parcels, and deliveries around the clock.
2. A postal van will visit the loading dock Tuesdays and Thursdays, 11:30-1:00, for registered mail and international parcels requiring a clerk.
3. The Main Street branch, a seven-minute walk, extends weekday hours to 7 p.m. starting July 1.

Company mailrooms should redirect bulk shipping contracts to their courier accounts before the closing date. Questions about the locker system may be sent to building services.

Building Administration

questions.q: Why is the postal counter closing?
choices: The postal service is consolidating small branches
questions.exKo: 우정 당국이 소규모 지점을 통폐합하기 때문입니다.

questions.q: What requires the postal van rather than the locker?
questions.exKo: 등기와 국제 소포는 직원이 필요해 우편 차량을 이용해야 합니다.

questions.q: What will change at the Main Street branch?
questions.exKo: 7월 1일부터 평일 영업시간이 저녁 7시까지 연장됩니다.

passages.title: 회의 문화 개선 지침 공지
passages.passage:
MEETING GUIDELINES — EFFECTIVE IMMEDIATELY

Our meeting audit found employees spend an average of 14 hours a week in meetings, and rate a third of that time as unnecessary. The following guidelines now apply:

1. Default meeting length changes from 60 to 45 minutes, and from 30 to 25, leaving transition time between calls.
2. Every invitation must state a purpose and desired outcome; invitations without them may be declined without explanation.
3. Meetings with more than eight participants require an agenda distributed one day ahead.
4. Recurring meetings expire quarterly and must be actively renewed by the owner.

Decision meetings should end with owners and deadlines recorded in the minutes. Status updates belong in written form first; use meetings to discuss exceptions, not to read reports aloud.

The guidelines will be reviewed after three months against calendar data.

Operations Excellence Team

questions.q: What did the meeting audit find?
choices: A third of meeting time is rated unnecessary
questions.exKo: 주 14시간 회의 중 3분의 1이 불필요하다고 평가되었습니다.

questions.q: What may happen to invitations without a stated purpose?
choices: They may be declined without explanation
questions.exKo: 목적과 기대 결과가 없는 초대는 설명 없이 거절해도 됩니다.

questions.q: What is said about status updates?
choices: They belong in written form first
questions.exKo: 상태 보고는 우선 문서로 공유하고 회의에서는 예외만 논의합니다.

passages.title: 프리미엄 사무 의자 광고
passages.passage:
SITWELL AURA — THE CHAIR YOUR BACK HAS BEEN ASKING FOR

You sit 1,700 hours a year. The SitWell Aura makes every one of them count, with a spine-following backrest that moves as you lean and armrests adjustable in four directions.

Developed with physical therapists and tested by 2,000 office workers over 18 months, the Aura reduced reported lower-back discomfort by 52 percent in our study group. The breathable mesh stays cool, and every material is certified low-emission for indoor air quality.

Assembled in 10 minutes with two included tools. Try the Aura risk-free for 60 days — return shipping is on us if it's not love. Corporate volume pricing and showroom visits available. Your back will thank you at sitwell.com.

questions.q: How was the chair developed?
choices: With physical therapists and long-term user testing
questions.exKo: 물리치료사와 공동 개발하고 2,000명이 18개월간 테스트했습니다.

questions.q: What result came from the study group?
questions.exKo: 요통 호소가 52% 감소했습니다.

questions.q: What does the 60-day trial include?
questions.exKo: 마음에 들지 않으면 반품 배송비도 회사가 부담합니다.

passages.title: 채용 박람회 참가 기업 모집 광고
passages.passage:
RECRUIT AT THE HARBOR CAREER FAIR — MARCH 21-22

Meet 5,000 candidates in two days. The Harbor Career Fair returns to the Exhibition Center with dedicated halls for technology, healthcare, logistics, and finance employers.

Booth packages from $1,200 include furniture, power, Wi-Fi, and your logo in the fair app, which candidates use to book conversations with your recruiters in advance — last year, pre-booked meetings led to twice as many follow-up interviews as walk-ups.

New this year: a same-day interview suite bookable in hourly blocks, and an employer branding workshop on the evening before the fair. Early registration by January 31 saves 15 percent and guarantees hall preference. Half of last year's exhibitors rebooked on site — spaces go quickly. Register at harborfair.com/employers.

questions.q: What advantage did pre-booked meetings show?
choices: Twice as many follow-up interviews as walk-ups
questions.exKo: 사전 예약 미팅은 현장 방문보다 후속 면접 성사율이 2배였습니다.

questions.q: What is new this year?
choices: An interview suite and a branding workshop
questions.exKo: 당일 면접실 대여와 전야 브랜딩 워크숍이 신설되었습니다.

questions.q: What does early registration guarantee?
choices: A 15 percent discount and hall preference
questions.exKo: 1월 31일까지 등록 시 15% 할인과 홀 우선 배정을 받습니다.

passages.title: 중고 사무기기 리퍼브 시장 성장 기사
passages.passage:
MARKET REPORT — Refurbished office electronics have moved from budget fallback to first choice for many firms, with the market growing 28 percent last year, according to industry tracker TechCycle. Laptops and monitors lead the category, typically selling at 40 to 60 percent of new prices with one-year warranties.

Buyers cite two motives in surveys: cost, and sustainability targets that count avoided electronics waste. Several large companies now require managers to justify buying new when a certified refurbished option exists.

Supply is the bottleneck. Refurbishers depend on corporate lease returns, and three-year lease cycles mean today's supply reflects purchases made during the last upgrade wave. TechCycle expects supply to loosen next year as pandemic-era fleets reach end of lease, potentially pushing prices down another 10 percent.

questions.q: How has the refurbished market changed?
choices: It became a first choice rather than a fallback
questions.exKo: 리퍼브 제품이 차선책에서 우선 선택지로 바뀌며 28% 성장했습니다.

questions.q: What do some large companies now require?
choices: Justification for buying new over refurbished
questions.exKo: 인증 리퍼브 제품이 있는데 새 제품을 살 경우 사유를 요구합니다.

questions.q: Why is supply expected to loosen next year?
choices: Pandemic-era fleets reach end of lease
questions.exKo: 팬데믹 시기 도입 장비들의 리스가 만료되기 때문입니다.

passages.title: 지역 상점 공동 배송망 기사
passages.passage:
PORTSMITH — Forty independent shops in the Old Quarter have pooled resources to launch a shared delivery service, promising same-day delivery within the city for orders placed by 2 p.m. A single van route collects from all participating stores twice daily, replacing the patchwork of individual courier arrangements.

The shops formed a cooperative to run the service, each paying a monthly fee based on parcel volume. Delivery costs per parcel have fallen by about a third, and two part-time drivers were hired full-time.

The cooperative's next step is a joint web storefront where customers can fill one basket from multiple shops — a bookstore order and a bakery order arriving in one box. A grant from the city's small business fund will cover the site's development, with launch targeted for the holiday season.

questions.q: What did the shops create together?
questions.exKo: 40개 독립 상점이 공동 당일 배송망을 만들었습니다.

questions.q: How are service costs divided?
choices: Monthly fees based on parcel volume
questions.exKo: 각 상점이 물량에 따라 월 회비를 냅니다.

questions.q: What will the city grant fund?
choices: Development of a joint web storefront
questions.exKo: 여러 상점을 한 바구니에 담는 공동 온라인 상점 개발에 쓰입니다.

passages.title: 행사장 케이터링 인원 변경 문자
passages.passage:
Vera Stone (9:00 A.M.)
Morning! Final headcount for Friday's client reception: we're at 85, up from the 70 we quoted you.

Chef Malik (9:10 A.M.)
85 works. Same menu, or should we adjust? At that size I'd suggest two carving stations instead of one to avoid lines.

Vera Stone (9:12 A.M.)
Good call. Budget impact?

Chef Malik (9:14 A.M.)
The extra 15 guests add $825 at the per-head rate. Second station adds $150 for staffing. I can offset some of that — the salmon is well priced this week, swapping it for the beef course saves about $200.

Vera Stone (9:17 A.M.)
Do the swap. Net increase around $775 then?

Chef Malik (9:18 A.M.)
$775 exactly. I'll send the revised contract by noon. Setup still 4 P.M., service at 6?

Vera Stone (9:19 A.M.)
Confirmed. Thanks, Malik!

questions.q: Why does Chef Malik suggest a second carving station?
choices: To avoid lines with more guests
questions.exKo: 85명 규모에서는 줄이 길어지는 것을 막기 위해서입니다.

questions.q: How does the chef reduce the added cost?
questions.exKo: 이번 주 시세가 좋은 연어로 소고기 코스를 바꿔 200달러를 아낍니다.

questions.q: What will the chef send by noon?
questions.exKo: 정오까지 수정 계약서를 보내기로 합니다.

passages.title: 소프트웨어 버그 긴급 대응 문자
passages.passage:
Chen Wei (3:12 P.M.)
Support is getting calls — customers on the annual plan see a $0 renewal price on the checkout page.

Rosa Marin (3:13 P.M.)
Checking... confirmed. A currency update this morning broke the annual price display. Charging still works correctly — it's display only.

Chen Wei (3:15 P.M.)
Still bad — customers screenshot $0 and expect it. Legal says displayed price can be binding in some markets.

Rosa Marin (3:17 P.M.)
Agree. Two options: roll back the currency update (20 minutes, loses today's new exchange rates) or hotfix the display bug (about an hour).

Chen Wei (3:18 P.M.)
Roll back now, hotfix properly after. Can we pause the renewal emails going out at 4?

Rosa Marin (3:19 P.M.)
Pausing them now. Rollback starting — I'll confirm when prices display correctly.

Chen Wei (3:20 P.M.)
Thanks. I'll draft a note for support to send anyone who saw the $0 price.

questions.q: What is the bug's actual effect?
choices: Prices display wrongly but charging works
questions.exKo: 결제는 정상이며 표시 가격만 0달러로 나오는 문제입니다.

questions.q: Why is the display bug still serious?
choices: Displayed prices can be legally binding
questions.exKo: 일부 시장에서는 표시 가격이 법적 구속력을 가질 수 있기 때문입니다.

questions.q: What immediate plan is chosen?
choices: Roll back first, hotfix properly later
questions.exKo: 20분 걸리는 롤백을 먼저 하고 이후 제대로 수정하기로 합니다.
